exercises.name: Meadows Incline DB Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Lie down on your side on a ~30° bench. Start with the DB in front of you, raise the DB to parallel to the floor and lower the DB behind you, feeling a deep stretch in your delts, then reverse this motion (2 reps have now been completed). No pausing between reps.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Pull-Up
exercises.notes: 1.5x shoulder width overhand grip. Slow 2-3 second negative. Feel your lats pulling apart on the way down. Slight 0.5-1 second pause at the bottom, then lift your chest up and drive your elbows down as you lift yourself up. Don't be afraid to use assistance. Add weight if needed. Keep the form tight and controlled!

exercises.name: Flat Machine Chest Press
exercises.notes: 1 second pause on the chest while maintaining tension on the chest.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Low Row
exercises.notes: Set the chest pad up so you get a deep stretch on each rep.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Flye
exercises.notes: All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. Focus on feeling a deep stretch in your pecs at the bottom of each rep.

exercises.name: Ez Bar Preacher Curl
exercises.notes: Set up the cable at hand height and feel a deep stretch on each rep. Curl until the handle reaches the bench.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Lean forward over the machine to get a maximum stretch in your hamstrings.

exercises.name: Bottom-Half Smith Machine Squat
exercises.notes: All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. Once you are under the bar, set up your feet as you would a normal squat and then bring them forward ~3-6 inches. This will cause you to lean back into the bar slightly, allowing for a more upright squat, while also placing more tension on the quads. If your heels are raising at the bottom, you may need to bring your feet more forward. If your feet feel like they are slipping or your lower back is rounding at the bottom, try bringing your feet back a bit.

exercises.name: Glute-Ham Raise
exercises.notes: Cut out the top ~25% of the ROM, where there will be minimal tension on the hamstrings. Squeeze your hamstrings to pull yourself up!

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.notes: Set the seat back as far as it will go while still feeling comfortable. Grab the handles as hard as you can to pull your butt down into the seat. Use a 2-3 second negative. Feel your quads pulling apart on the negative.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.notes: 1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Instead of just going up onto your toes, think about rolling your ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Machine Hip Abduction
exercises.notes: If possible, use pads to increase the range of motion on the machine. Lean forward and grab onto the machine rails to stretch the glutes further.

exercises.name: Behind Back Cable Cuffed Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Focus on squeezing your lateral delt to move the weight.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Deficit Row
exercises.notes: Focus on getting a big stretch and touch your stomach/chest on each rep!

exercises.name: 30* Smith Incline Pres

exercises.name: Katana Triceps Extension
exercises.notes: Flare your elbows out at about 45° and keep your elbows locked in place as you complete the extensions.

On all sets, alternate full-ROM reps and half-ROM reps (i.e. do 1 rep with full-ROM, then 1 rep half-ROM (in the stretched/top half), then 1 rep full-ROM, then 1 rep half-ROM). Repeat until you've reached the target reps (partial reps count towards the rep count).

exercises.name: Super-Stretch Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.notes: Face side on to the machine and pull your arm across your body to pre-stretch your rear delt. Do reverse flyes 1 arm at a time. Start with your weaker arm.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
exercises.notes: Arc the EZ-bar slightly back behind your head. When you extend, keep the bar back behind your eye line. Use the inside (closer) grip option and allow the elbows to flare to a degree that feels comfortable. Once you hit failure on the final set, continue with lengthened partials in the bottom half of the ROM, until you can no longer achieve a full half rep.

exercises.name: DB RDL
exercises.notes: The RPE is intentionally low here because these will cause a lot of muscle damage. Don't be tempted to go too heavy. To keep tension on the hamstrings, stop about 75% of the way to full lockout on each rep (i.e. stay in the bottom 3/4 of the range of motion).

exercises.name: Belt Squat
exercises.notes: Get as deep as you can without excessive back rounding. Control the negative and do a slight pause at the bottom of each rep.

exercises.name: DB Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Reps are per leg. Start with your weaker leg. Squat deep. After the final set, perform a quad static stretch for each leg for 30 seconds.

exercises.name: Bottom-Half Standing Calf Raise
exercises.notes: All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. 1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Instead of just going up onto your toes, think about rolling your ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet.

exercises.name: Machine Hip Adduction
exercises.notes: Mind-muscle connection with your inner thighs. These are great for adding thigh mass from the front! Push them hard!

exercises.name: Weak Point Exercise 1 (optional)
exercises.notes: Decide on your weak point using The Weak Point Table in your Hypertrophy Handbook. Perform ONE of the exercises listed under Exercise 1 for the sets and reps provided here.

exercises.name: Weak Point Exercise 2 (optional)
exercises.notes: If your weak point is feeling recovered (not sore or fatigued) then feel free to hit Exercise 2. If your weak point is feeling tired or sore, do not perform the second weak point exercise this week.

exercises.name: Bottom-Half Machine Preacher Curl
exercises.notes: All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. Smooth, controlled reps. Mind-muscle connection with the biceps.

exercises.name: Triceps Diverging Pressdown (Long Rope or 2 Ropes)
exercises.notes: Use two long ropes or one long rope. Lean slightly forward, flare your elbows slightly out and keep your arms back in line with your torso. Then do triceps pressdowns, getting a full, big squeeze at the bottom.

exercises.name: Inverse DB Zottman Curl
exercises.notes: Do a hammer curl on the positive, then turn your palms facing up at the top and use a palms-up grip on the negative.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Pushup (AMRAP)
exercises.notes: As many reps as possible. Keep them controlled! Roughly shoulder-width hand placement. Keep elbows tucked close to your sides. Smooth, controlled reps.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Don't just bend at your hips, use your abs to lower yourself down under control and pull yourself back up. If you don't have the core strength to get all the way extended at the bottom, try to progressively increase the ROM week to week.

exercises.name: Meadows Incline DB Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Lie down on your side on a ~30° bench. Start with the DB in front of you, raise the DB to parallel to the floor and lower the DB behind you, feeling a deep stretch in your delts, then reverse this motion (2 reps have now been completed). No pausing between reps.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Think about pulling your elbows "down" and "in". Once you hit the Last Set RPE on the final set, switch to partial reps. These should be the top half of the ROM. Stop once you have 0-1 half reps left in the tank.

exercises.name: Flat Smith Machine Bench Press
exercises.notes: 1 second pause on the chest on each rep while maintaining tension on the pecs. Once you hit the Last Set RPE on the final set, switch to partial reps. These should be the bottom half of the ROM. Stop once you have 0-1 half reps left in the tank.

exercises.name: Dual-Handle Elbows-Out Cable Row
exercises.notes: Flare your elbows out ~45°. Smooth, controlled reps. Once you hit the Last Set RPE on the final set, switch to partial reps. These should be the bottom half of the ROM. Stop once you have 0-1 half reps left in the tank.

exercises.name: Bottom-Half Pec Deck
exercises.notes: All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. Focus on feeling a deep stretch in your pecs at the bottom of each rep.

exercises.name: Seated Super-Bayesian High Cable Curl
exercises.notes: Set up the cable at hand height and feel a deep stretch on each rep. Curl until the handle reaches the bench.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Lean forward over the machine to get a maximum stretch in your hamstrings. Once you hit failure on the final set, continue with lengthened partials in the top half of the ROM, until you can no longer achieve a full half rep.

exercises.name: Bottom-Half Hack Squat
exercises.notes: All reps and sets are to be performed in the bottom half of the ROM. Allow your knees to come forward (past your toes). Focus the tension on your quads.

exercises.name: Single-Leg DB Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Slow 2-3 second negative. Explode with control on the way up. Squeeze your glutes hard at the top of the movement.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.notes: Set the seat back as far as it will go while still feeling comfortable. Grab the handles as hard as you can to pull your butt down into the seat. Use a 2-3 second negative. Feel your quads pulling apart on the negative. Once you hit failure on the final set, continue with lengthened partials in the bottom half of the ROM, until you can no longer achieve a full half rep.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.intensityTechnique: Weighted Static Hold(30 sec hold in the stretch)
exercises.notes: 1-2 second pause at the bottom of each rep. Instead of just going up onto your toes, think about rolling your ankle back and forth on the balls of your feet. For the weighted static hold, after the final rep of the final set, rather than reracking the weight immediately, pause at the very bottom of the ROM (with full tension still on the calves) and maintain this hold for 30 seconds.

exercises.name: Machine Hip Abduction
exercises.notes: If possible, use pads to increase the range of motion on the machine. Lean forward and grab onto the machine rails to stretch the glutes further.

exercises.name: High-Cable Cuffed Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Focus on squeezing your lateral delt to move the weight. Once you hit failure on the final set, continue with lengthened partials in the bottom half of the ROM, until you can no longer achieve a full half rep.

exercises.name: Deficit Pendlay Row
exercises.notes: Stand on a bumper plate. Focus on getting a big stretch and touch your stomach/chest on each rep! Once you hit the Last Set RPE on the final set, switch to partial reps. These should be the bottom half of the ROM. Stop once you have 0-1 half reps left in the tank.
